build_Generator: build a BigGAN Generator model with configurable resolution, channel width, and class-conditional batch normalization
build_Discriminator: build a BigGAN Discriminator model with spectral-normalized convolutions and projection-based class conditioning
build_G_D: build a parallelized G_D module that jointly runs the Generator and Discriminator to minimize cross-GPU communication
run_G_arch: run G_arch to generate a dictionary of generator architecture configs for resolutions 32 through 512
run_D_arch: run D_arch to generate a dictionary of discriminator architecture configs for resolutions 32 through 256
